## Improve the way you diagnose, monitor and manage your patients

With the Afinion™ 2 System, there’s no need to send test results to the lab or spend time tracking
them down. That way you can keep your focus where it belongs – on the patient.

[ Discover more ][64]
[Hero banner Image]
[Hero banner Image]
[Hero banner Image]



## MAKE AN IMPACT WITH
## i-STAT 1

A portable, handheld blood analyzer that delivers lab-quality results in minutes at the point of
care.

[ Find Out More ][65]



## Detect Dengue early with rapid testing

Dengue remains a threat and its symptoms can range from mild to severe flu-like. With high
sensitivity and specificity and results in 15 minutes, Bioline™ Dengue Duo is a fast solution for
field hospitals and large-scale testing.

[ learn more ][66]

###### Point of Care Highlights

[ [Redesign the Medicine Cabinet] [Redesign the Medicine Cabinet] [Redesign the Medicine Cabinet]
][67]

### Lab-quality results in ≈10 minutes

*i-STAT cardiac troponin* I (cTnI), can be used to obtain quantitative measurement of cardiac
troponin I (cTnI).

[ Learn More ][68]
[ [diabetes solutions] [diabetes solutions] [diabetes solutions] ][69]

### Stay Ahead of Diabetes with HbA1c Testing

Diagnose diabetes and better manage patients with point-of-care Hb1Ac testing. Get quick, accurate
results enabling immediate diagnosis for better management.

[ DISCOVER MORE ][70]
[ [Covid-Antigen-Selftest] [Covid-Antigen-Selftest] [Covid-Antigen-Selftest] ][71]

### A new standard in sensitivity Determine™ HBsAg 2

The world's most sensitive rapid diagnostic test for detection of Hepatitis B surface antigen for
use with serum, plasma or whole blood.

[ Learn More ][72]



## The answers you’re looking for.

Discover how our rapid diagnostics solutions help address some of the world’s greatest healthcare
challenges – including yours.

[ FIND YOUR SOLUTION ][73]

    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable

    cancer and specialty care.

    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

## We are Roche

We combine life-changing diagnostics and medicines to take on the toughest healthcare challenges,
those that place the greatest strain on patients, families, communities, and health systems. 

Guided by the experiences of patients, we are determined to prevent, stop and cure diseases so
people can live healthier, longer lives.

[Man holding a surfing board smiling with a ocean in the background.]

Our strategy

### Restoring health through medicines

We cure diseases by identifying the cause of a patient’s condition and restoring health through
curative medicines.

## Welcome to ALMS Community Health Center

### Clear care. Honest pricing. Real relationships.

At ALMS Community Health Center, we believe healthcare should be accessible, affordable and easy to
understand. That’s why we use an individual pricing model, you only pay for the services you
receive, with no surprise bills or unnecessary fees.


We proudly serve Mansfield, TX (76063) and surrounding Dallas–Fort Worth communities, offering
comprehensive medical services in one convenient location.

## Why Patients Choose ALMS

#### At ALMS Community Health Center, we are committed to delivering accessible, patient-centered
#### healthcare that prioritizes clarity, respect and long-term health outcomes.

### Integrated care that simplifies healthcare
* Primary care, pediatric and mental health services in one location
* On-site laboratory testing for faster diagnosis
* Coordinated care across providers and services
* Reduced need for outside referrals


This integrated approach improves efficiency, continuity and patient outcomes.

### Flexible care delivery options
* Primary care, pediatric and mental health services in one location
* On-site laboratory testing for faster diagnosis
* Coordinated care across providers and services
* Reduced need for outside referrals


This integrated approach improves efficiency, continuity and patient outcomes.

### Care built around the patient
### experience
* Taking time with every patient
* Explaining conditions and treatment options in plain language
* Treating every individual with dignity, respect and compassion
* Creating a comfortable, supportive care environment


Healthcare should never feel rushed, confusing or impersonal.

### Transparent and predictable healthcare costs
* Clear pricing shared before care begins
* No membership fees or hidden charges
* Affordable options for uninsured and underinsured patients
* Designed for individuals managing high deductibles


Our pricing model helps patients stay informed, empowered and in control of their healthcare
decisions.

## Our Services

### Comprehensive care for every stage of life.

ALMS Community Health Center provides integrated healthcare services including primary care,
pediatric care, mental health services, chronic disease management, laboratory testing and flexible
care delivery options such as in-office visits, home visits and telehealth.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[ What types of diagnostic products does Astam Diagnostics manufacture?
][94]

Astam Diagnostics manufactures a wide range of In-Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) kits and medical devices,
including Biochemistry Reagents, Rapid Diagnostic Test Kits (Immunochromatography), Immunology kits,
and advanced laboratory consumables for hospitals and diagnostic centers.

 

[ Does Astam Diagnostics provide OEM and private label manufacturing services?
][95]

They offer end-to-end OEM and private label manufacturing services for IVD kits and medical devices,
custom-tailored to the formulations, packaging, branding, and regulatory compliance standards of
global healthcare brands.

 

[ What regulatory and quality certifications does your manufacturing facility hold?
][96]

The manufacturing plant operates under stringent international quality protocols. Astam Diagnostics
is ISO 13485:2016 certified, with products manufactured in compliance with CDSCO regulations and CE
certification standards.

 

[ How can global distributors or laboratories request a bulk supply or custom quote?
][97]

For wholesale distribution, laboratory tenders, or bulk supply requirements, interested parties can
fill out the corporate enquiry form on the website or email the B2B procurement cell directly. The
company provides scalable logistics for both domestic (Pan-India) and international shipments.

[ Do you ensure batch-to-batch consistency for your biochemistry reagents and rapid kits?
][98]

The in-house R&D facility and quality assurance teams perform rigorous analytical and clinical
evaluations on every batch, guaranteeing exceptional sensitivity, specificity, and long-term
stability across all diagnostic products.

[ Where can individuals or small clinics buy retail quantities of your products online?
][99]

While the main website handles bulk corporate contracts, a dedicated e-commerce storefront is
available for retail orders. Small clinics, laboratories, and individual clients can purchase
selected medical devices at shop.astamdiagno.com.

## Supporting Ebola Response: Rapid Diagnostics and Global Expertise

Advancing our commitment to public health, our teams are partnering to actively support Ebola
response efforts on the ground, expand diagnostic testing and strengthen laboratory capabilities.

[ Explore the Ebola Resource Hub ][207]

## Protecting Food. Protecting People.

Safe food isn't just a privilege; it is a necessity. An estimated 600 million people fall ill after
eating contaminated food annually, with approximately 420,000 losing their lives. Efficient,
reliable and fast diagnostic solutions play a crucial role in safety, quality and protecting
consumers worldwide.

[ Discover Food & Quality Safety Solutions ][208]

## Annual Report: Achievements Building a Healthier Future

bioMérieux’s Annual Report highlights the achievements shaping public health, innovation, and
environmental responsibility for our future. From strengthening the fight against AMR and sepsis to
accelerating sustainable solutions, our work continues driving better outcomes for people, our
communities and the planet.

[ Explore the 2025 Annual Report ][209]

resources. Leverage scientific materials, webinars, symposium highlights, case studies, and more to

## Manufacturing ][211]

With GENE-UP® PROBIOTIC SPECIES ID, bioMérieux introduces a first-of-its-kind commercialized
species-level identification PCR solution for in-house quality control teams and external laboratory
partners.
[ Discover more ][212]

* ## [ bioMérieux submits 510(k) to U.S. FDA for the latest versions of the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY®
  ## Gastrointestinal Panels to enhance detection of gastrointestinal pathogens ][213]
  
  bioMérieux, a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, today announces the submission of
  the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY® Gastrointestinal 1.1 (GI1.1) Panel and the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY®
  Gastrointestinal 1.1 (GI1.1) Panel Mid to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for 510(k)
  review. These PCR* molecular panels test 22 and 11, respectively, of the most common bacteria,
  viruses, and parasites associated with gastroenteritis, all from one sample, with results
  available in approximately one hour.
  [ Discover more ][214]
* ## [ Advancing Women’s Health with Rapid Diagnostics: bioMérieux files a Dual 510(k) /CLIA Waiver
  ## application to the FDA for the BIOFIRE® SPOTFIRE® Vaginitis Panel ][215]
  
  bioMérieux, a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, has submitted a Dual 510(k)/CLIA
  Waiver application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the BIOFIRE® SPOTFIRE®
  Vaginitis (VG) Panel. This automated, multiplex PCR test can simultaneously detect the most common
  causes of vaginitis in 20 minutes, directly at the point of care. With this submission, bioMérieux
  is intending to expand into women’s and sexual health, bringing rapid and accurate diagnostics
  closer to patients.
  [ Discover more ][216]
* ## [ bioMérieux introduces Salmonella testing kit on GENE-UP® TYPER to support root cause analysis
  ## in the food industry ][217]
  
  bioMérieux, a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, today introduces the launch of
  GENE-UP® TYPER SLM, a new real-time PCR solution supporting rapid root cause analysis by
  discriminating Salmonella in the food industry environments.
  [ Discover more ][218]

### Support the community

Thank you for visiting The Global Health Network, please take a moment to read this important
message. As you know, our aim is to enable equity in access to research knowledge and this is
successfully delivering support and training to 1000’s of research teams all over the world. But we
need your support!. If you have benefited from this research skills and knowledge sharing facility,
please help us sustain this remarkable and unique provision of information for those who could
otherwise not access such support and training. We would be really grateful if you could make a
donation or ask your employer or organisation to contribute to the costs of maintaining this
platform and the generation of new contents for all users. Just a small contribution from everyone
who can afford to pay would keep this available for those who cannot. Thank you, we really
appreciate your part in this community effort to better equity in global health research.

### Support the community

Thank you for visiting The Global Health Network, please take a moment to read this important
message. As you know, our aim is to enable equity in access to research knowledge and this is
successfully delivering support and training to 1000’s of research teams all over the world. But we
need your support!. If you have benefited from this research skills and knowledge sharing facility,
please help us sustain this remarkable and unique provision of information for those who could
otherwise not access such support and training. We would be really grateful if you could make a
donation or ask your employer or organisation to contribute to the costs of maintaining this
platform and the generation of new contents for all users. Just a small contribution from everyone
who can afford to pay would keep this available for those who cannot. Thank you, we really
appreciate your part in this community effort to better equity in global health research.

## Quick and Accurate Strep Test for Identifying Infections

Strep Test: A Revolution in Rapid DiagnosticsIn recent years, rapid diagnostic tests have become
increasingly popular in healthcare settings, allowing for faster and more accurate diagnoses without
the need for extensive lab work. Among these tests, the Strep Test has emerged as a game-changing
technology for identifying strep throat, a common yet potentially dangerous infection.Developed by a
leading diagnostics company, the Strep Test is a rapid antigen test that detects the presence of
group A streptococcus bacteria in a patient’s throat. Using a simple throat swab, the test delivers
results in just a few minutes, allowing for immediate treatment and faster recovery times.But what
sets the Strep Test apart from other rapid tests is its high level of accuracy. According to
clinical studies, the test has a sensitivity of 95-98% and a specificity of 98-99%, making it one of
the most reliable rapid diagnostics available. And unlike traditional culture tests, which can take
up to two days to produce results, the Strep Test allows for same-day diagnosis and treatment.In
addition to its speed and accuracy, the Strep Test is also incredibly easy to use. With no need for
specialized equipment or training, healthcare providers can administer the test in any setting, from
hospitals to clinics to pharmacies. And with results available in just minutes, patients can quickly
receive the treatment they need to avoid potentially serious complications.But the Strep Test’s
benefits go beyond its diagnostic capabilities. By providing fast and accurate results, the test
also helps reduce unnecessary antibiotic use, which can lead to the development of
antibiotic-resistant bacteria. With the Strep Test, healthcare providers can confidently prescribe
antibiotics only to patients who actually need them, while avoiding overuse that can harm both
individual patients and society as a whole.And with the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic highlighting the
urgent need for rapid and accurate diagnostics, the Strep Test’s potential applications expand
beyond strep throat. As healthcare providers work to quickly identify and isolate infected
individuals, rapid tests like the Strep Test can play a critical role in limiting the spread of the
virus.Overall, the Strep Test represents a major breakthrough in the field of rapid diagnostics,
offering fast, accurate, and accessible detection of strep throat and other bacterial infections. By
providing a reliable alternative to traditional culture tests, the Strep Test has the power to
transform how we diagnose and treat common illnesses, reducing avoidable hospitalizations and deaths
and promoting better overall health outcomes. With its potential for widespread use and ongoing
innovation, the Strep Test is likely to remain an essential tool in healthcare settings for years to
come.

With nearly 40 years of experience in distributing and marketing medical devices, diagnostic kits,
and advanced healthcare solutions, Hester Diagnostics is dedicated to strengthening India’s
healthcare landscape.

We partner with leading global companies from the United States, Japan, Europe, China and Israel to
bring innovative, high-quality products to India. Our presence spans 100+ cities, supported by a
dedicated sales and marketing team that ensures efficient reach, reliable service, and successful
market entry for new products, creating strong brand value for our international partners.

[Bringing Global Healthcare Excellence To India]

With over four decades in the industry, we’ve built a strong presence across India’s healthcare
landscape, reaching hospitals in 100+ cities, touching thousands of lives each year, and forging

[[ ABO & RhD Blood Grouping Kit]][106] [ABO & RhD Blood Grouping Kit][107]

Exclusive method

Solid-phase method

Accuracy rate: 100%



** **

**INTENDED USE**

The kit is intended to qualitatively detect ABO blood group system A/B antigen and Rh blood group
system D antigen in fresh finger prick blood/ anticoagulated venous whole blood.

Human blood contains a wide variety of blood groups, of which ABO and RhD are the most common. Blood
group identification is a crucial test item prior to clinical blood transfusion, and has important
clinical significance. When the blood group antigen on the surface of red blood cells comes in
contact with the corresponding antibody, red blood cells will undergo agglutination reaction, which
will eventually lead to hemolysis of red blood cells and endanger life. As a result, correct
identification of ABO and RhD blood antigens is an essential prerequisite to ensure safe blood
transfusion and avoid related diseases.



[Read More][108]

The Advanced Quality HIV Self-Test is a colloidal gold enhanced, rapid immunochromatographic assay
for qualitative detection of antibodies to Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) in human fingerstick
whole blood. The test is intended for use by untrained lay users in a private setting as a self-test
to aid in the diagnosis of HIV infection.

# WHAT MAKES JACKAROO ANGUS STUD DIFFERENT

## Boutique Black Angus Stud with a unique, visionary approach

With a focus on pedigree, we combine in-demand, unique, hard-to-source and emerging elite sire
genetics with hand-selected females to produce cattle and embryos which are just as distinctive as
they are exceptional.

 

Utilising both cutting-edge new age analysis and analytics underpinned by the traditional
fundamental tenets and approaches of the Angus breed, we find a balance which combines the best of
both worlds to make intelligent, optimal breeding decisions.

 

Bred tough at the base of the Snowy Mountains in NSW and in South West Queensland, we have been
breeding and raising quality cattle since 2008. We take a great deal of pride in what we do and
ensuring that we provide reliable, quality Black Angus genetics to our customers.

# WHAT MAKES JACKAROO ANGUS STUD DIFFERENT

## Boutique Black Angus Stud with a unique, visionary approach

With a focus on pedigree, we combine in-demand, unique, hard-to-source and emerging elite sire
genetics with hand-selected females to produce cattle and embryos which are just as distinctive as
they are exceptional.

 

Utilising both cutting-edge new age analysis and analytics underpinned by the traditional
fundamental tenets and approaches of the Angus breed, we find a balance which combines the best of
both worlds to make intelligent, optimal breeding decisions.

 

Bred tough at the base of the Snowy Mountains in NSW and in South West Queensland, we have been
breeding and raising quality cattle since 2008. We take a great deal of pride in what we do and
ensuring that we provide reliable, quality Black Angus genetics to our customers.

Drug Of Abuse Rapid Screen Tests
[Jal Medical provides infectious diseases rapid screen test kits for detecting diseases like HIV,
Syphilis, Influenza, Hepatitis, Tuberculosis, Vibrio Cholerae, Malaria, Dengue, etc. These diseases
are highly infectious in nature and hence must be detected early so that the individuals are treated
easily and the disease is not transferred to others as well. HIV, for example, is a virus that
targets and alters the entire immune system of the humans. It is very important that it gets
detected at an early stage so that the virus causes less damage to the body. HIV stands for Human
immunodeficiency virus and if left untreated for a considerable period of time can lead to AIDS. HIV
has the tendency to target and infiltrate the white blood cells, which ultimately deters the body’s
capacity to combat other diseases. It is a lifelong infection and receiving treatment and effective
management goes a long way in preventing HIV from reaching a severe level. The risk of the virus
getting passed on to other individuals in also reduced.]
Infectious Diseases Rapid Screen Tests
[Jal Medical offers product line such as iCare fertility rapid test kits. A rapid diagnostic test is
a quick and easy diagnostic test to be performed with the help of rapid test kits. It is mostly
suitable for preliminary or emergency medical screening. The fertility rapid test kits section
comprises of ovulation test kit, menopause test kit, and pregnancy test kits. The ovulation test kit
helps in predicting the fertility cycle for female to either aid or avoid pregnancy. For normal
women, the Luteinizing Hormone or LH increases substantially in the middle of menstrual cycle. This
hormone is found in the urine, which is detected using the ovulation test kit. An Increase in the LH
expedites the ovulation process in which the egg is released periodically from normal fertile woman.
The kit consists of a cassette in which specimen is dropped. The capillary action carries this
specimen to migrate along the membrane and reaches the test zone. As the traces of LH in the
specimen reaches the test zone of the membrane, it results in the formation of a colored line that
denotes a positive result. Absence of colored line signifies negative result.]

Drug Of Abuse Rapid Screen Tests
[Jal Medical provides infectious diseases rapid screen test kits for detecting diseases like HIV,
Syphilis, Influenza, Hepatitis, Tuberculosis, Vibrio Cholerae, Malaria, Dengue, etc. These diseases
are highly infectious in nature and hence must be detected early so that the individuals are treated
easily and the disease is not transferred to others as well. HIV, for example, is a virus that
targets and alters the entire immune system of the humans. It is very important that it gets
detected at an early stage so that the virus causes less damage to the body. HIV stands for Human
immunodeficiency virus and if left untreated for a considerable period of time can lead to AIDS. HIV
has the tendency to target and infiltrate the white blood cells, which ultimately deters the body’s
capacity to combat other diseases. It is a lifelong infection and receiving treatment and effective
management goes a long way in preventing HIV from reaching a severe level. The risk of the virus
getting passed on to other individuals in also reduced.]
Infectious Diseases Rapid Screen Tests
[Jal Medical offers product line such as iCare fertility rapid test kits. A rapid diagnostic test is
a quick and easy diagnostic test to be performed with the help of rapid test kits. It is mostly
suitable for preliminary or emergency medical screening. The fertility rapid test kits section
comprises of ovulation test kit, menopause test kit, and pregnancy test kits. The ovulation test kit
helps in predicting the fertility cycle for female to either aid or avoid pregnancy. For normal
women, the Luteinizing Hormone or LH increases substantially in the middle of menstrual cycle. This
hormone is found in the urine, which is detected using the ovulation test kit. An Increase in the LH
expedites the ovulation process in which the egg is released periodically from normal fertile woman.
The kit consists of a cassette in which specimen is dropped. The capillary action carries this
specimen to migrate along the membrane and reaches the test zone. As the traces of LH in the
specimen reaches the test zone of the membrane, it results in the formation of a colored line that
denotes a positive result. Absence of colored line signifies negative result.]

[High Accuracy HIV Rapid Test Kits Guide for Early Detection]

### High Accuracy HIV Rapid Test Kits Guide for Early Detection

The Essential Guide to High-Accuracy HIV Rapid Test Kits Early detection is the cornerstone of
effective HIV management and prevention. Modern hiv rapid test kits have revolutionized the way
healthcare providers and clinics screen for the virus, providing reliable results in a fraction of
the time required by traditional laboratory methods. By utilizing advanced immunochromatographic
technology, these kits allow for immediate decision-making and prompt initiation of treatment. In
this comprehensive guide, we will explore the technical mechanisms, clinical advantages, and the
critical role these diagnostic tools play in global health initiatives and pharmaceutical
manufacturing standards.

View Details
][151] [
[Choosing a Reliable and Accurate HIV Self Test Kit Guide]

### Choosing a Reliable and Accurate HIV Self Test Kit Guide

Taking control of your sexual health is one of the most responsible steps you can take for your
long-term well-being. An hiv self test kit provides a discreet, fast, and accurate way to screen for
the virus from the comfort and privacy of your own home. By removing the barriers of clinic visits
and long waiting times, these diagnostic tools encourage more frequent testing and earlier
detection. Early diagnosis is critical, as it allows individuals to access life-saving
antiretroviral therapy ART promptly, ensuring a healthier life and preventing further transmission.

View Details
][152] [
[Choosing the Right hiv test kit set for Reliable Diagnostics]

### Choosing the Right hiv test kit set for Reliable Diagnostics

Choosing the Right hiv test kit set for Reliable Diagnostics In the modern healthcare landscape,
early and accurate detection of viral infections is critical for effective patient management and
public health. A high-quality hiv test kit set provides the essential tools required for rapid
screening and diagnostic confirmation. Whether utilized in clinical laboratories, community health
centers, or specialized diagnostic facilities, the precision of the testing components determines

Taking control of your sexual health is one of the most responsible steps you can take for your

the virus from the comfort and privacy of your own home. By removing the barriers of clinic visits
and long waiting times, these diagnostic tools encourage more frequent testing and earlier
detection. Early diagnosis is critical, as it allows individuals to access life-saving
antiretroviral therapy ART promptly, ensuring a healthier life and preventing further transmission.

## ABOUT US

# THE BEST TELEHEALTH SOLUTIONS PROVIDER

**SK-Telemed GmbH **is a complete system integrator for IT solutions in healthcare business
processes. Collaboration with industry leaders in software and hardware, high competence of our
team, successful experience of implemented projects and stable growth of demand for our services
open another level of workflow for our clients. We deliver healthcare software development services
for hospitals, doctors, patients ensuring high level of digital healthcare service and health
management. Healthcare providers with our software solutions improve medical workflows, enhance
treatment, diagnostics and organize secure data transfer between healthcare departments.

SK-Telemed GmbH has passed the audits and is now certified according to ISO 9001:2015 and
13485:2016. [Read more about SK-Telemed GmbH][15].

**SK-Telemed GmbH is a member of **
**AAL Austria, Telemed Austria**

#### Mission

We increase a level of healthcare services with help of cutting-edge IT solutions.
With our solutions, healthcare providers improve medical workflow, enhance treatment, diagnostic and
continuous monitoring, organize secure data transfer.

#### Position

Our digital solutions connect doctors, patients, and partners. We develop precise digital tools for
remote monitoring, treatment, communication and care that really elevate the quality of medical
services especially in the COVID-19 era.

#### Strategy

We use mHealth, telehealth, IoMT, AI algorithms and other technologies to facilitate a diagnostic
process, to enhance a monitoring of the patients health status, to provide a continuous care, and to
give proper treatment solutions.

## PRODUCTS

[IDIS2GO]

**Telehealth medical diagnostic system IDIS2GO is a telemetry solution for remote diagnostic. The
diagnostic clinic just in one bag!**
* Open platform with number of portable connected devices (12-channel ECG, urine analizer,
  spirometer, blood pressure, glucometer, SpO2, dermatoscope, digital stethoscope, wireless doppler,
  fetal doppler, etc).
* Diagnostic in remote locations: rural areas, transport, production and military units.
* Remote access for medical specialists to diagnostic results.
* AI for doctor decision support.

[More information][16]

**Worldwide Doctor-to-Patient communication and monitoring platform. Show2Doc connects with the
portable medical devices. The complete health monitoring for home use!**

It allows virtual care with possibility of complete outpatient treatment without physical visits to
clinic: 
* convenient task manager
* chat for instant feedback
* doctor prescription fulfillment control
* user-friendly intuitive interface
* patient diary
* videocalls in necessary cases

[More information][17]
[Patient portal with the web and mobile app Medcard24]
[Medcard24]

**Patient portal with the web and mobile app. Medcard24 allows you to:**
* find doctors or clinics
* schedule the appointments
* check the personal medical data in EHRs/EMRs
* book the online-consultations
* recieve the electronic prescriptions
* find medicine in the nearest pharmacy and purchase it online

[More information][18]
[ePrescription]

**Unified system for prescription registration, accounting and monitoring**.

Single e-prescriptions database.
Identification doctor, pharmacist and medical prescription. Online reporting.

**This program was created to:**
* medical prescription process automation
* control of distribution of medicines to pharmacies
* creation of reimbursement register of drug costs
* analytical reports generating

[More information][19]
[e-prescriptions database]
[Telemedicine portal]
[Telemed24]

**Telemedicine platform**

Complete telemedicine module, with doctor’s time management, Doctor-to-Doctor and Patient-to-Doctor
remote consultation workflows, electronic health record (EHR), diagnostic results and video calling.

**Telemedicine portal includes:**
* Telemedicine consultation
* Video calling
* Home telemedicine
* Search of consultants

# Why Choose Vijaya Diagnostic Centre?

It begins with a question—a doubt, a discomfort, a concern that brings you searching for clarity. At
that moment, when health feels uncertain, what one needs most is reassurance—the quiet confidence
that someone will handle your concern with care, the certainty that the answers you seek will come
with both precision and thoughtfulness.

## Built on Trust, Backed by Expertise

Since our inception in 1981, we have remained true to one simple promise—diagnostics with a human
touch. From a modest beginning, we have grown into one of India’s most respected diagnostic
networks. We have achieved this feat by providing top-quality diagnostic care and earning the trust
of numerous customers across the country.

Our team today is made up of over 3000 dedicated professionals, including 300+ of India’s leading
specialised and super-specialised radiologists and pathologists. Along with their deep expertise and
technical skills, they bring empathy, compassion, and a strong commitment to patient care.

Every test we conduct is handled with precision and responsibility—because we understand that your
medical reports aren’t just numbers, they’re the foundation of your peace of mind.

We also offer a wide range of [health packages][139] curated for every age group and lifestyle,
ensuring preventive care is accessible and personalised. Understanding that healthcare is not just
about treatment but also about prevention, we have curated a comprehensive suite of preventive
health check-up packages tailored to diverse age groups, health conditions, and lifestyles.

## Accessible Care, Thoughtfully Delivered

Today, Vijaya is present in 6 states, across 25 cities with over [160 centres][140]. Each one of
these centres carries the same hallmark of care. Our centres are spread over multiple locations
across 25+ cities, which means there’s a Vijaya diagnostic centre near you whenever you want
effective diagnostic care. No matter which centre you visit, our philosophy remains unchanged:
offering patients consistent quality, accessible service, and unwavering integrity.

For those who cannot come to us because of health issues, age, or tight schedules, we come to them.
Our [home sample collection][141] service is not just a convenience—it’s a commitment to ensuring
that no one is left behind and care reaches the doorstep of those who need it the most.

## A Quiet Presence in Life’s Important Moments

Every day, people walk into our centres with concerns they may not always say out loud. Some come
alone; some are accompanied by loved ones. Some are looking for answers. Others simply want
reassurance. And in these quiet, crucial moments, we stand beside them, not just as professionals,
but as trusted partners in their journey towards better health.

## Numbers That Speak of Trust, Not Just Growth

Over the last 40+ years, Vijaya has quietly built a legacy rooted in both care and credibility. Our
strength lies in our people—3000+ skilled professionals, including 300+ specialised and super
specialised radiologists and pathologists who bring experience and empathy to their work. We’ve had
the privilege of serving 100+ million individuals, and we are trusted by 450+ organisations across
the country.

## Uncompromising on Quality and Accreditation

Quality is at the heart of Vijaya Diagnostic Centre’s operations—it’s a culture that’s ingrained in
our practices and deep-rooted in our professional approaches. Every process is governed by globally
recognised standards, ensuring your health is always the top priority. Our diagnostic laboratories
are accredited by NABL, our flagship centre is certified under ISO 9001:2015, and our operations
align with NABH protocols to ensure clinical excellence and patient safety.

## Because You Deserve Nothing Less

When you choose Vijaya Diagnostic Centre, you are choosing care that is personal, not transactional.
You are choosing an experience grounded in science and service rooted in empathy. You are choosing a
place where every step—from booking a diagnostic test to reporting—is designed around your comfort.

At every [diagnostic centre][142] under our network, the focus remains the same: accurate diagnosis,
timely reporting, seamless experience, and compassionate communication.

Most importantly, you are choosing a team that understands that behind every test lies a person—a
life, a story, and a hope. And that’s a responsibility we carry with pride.

## Trust Vijaya for Advanced Medical Care

Whether you are looking for a [radiology centre][143] or pathology tests, Vijaya Diagnostic Centre
is the first and ultimate choice. Our vision and reputation have made us the leading name in the
medical sector.

As one of the best [diagnostic centres][144], Vijaya offers world-class support and advanced care,
which can help clinicians diagnose the exact medical issue you are experiencing.

Get in touch with us for the best diagnostic support delivered with professionalism, care, and
empathy.

For any enquiries or more information, Call Us Today!

# Why Choose Vijaya Diagnostic Centre?

It begins with a question—a doubt, a discomfort, a concern that brings you searching for clarity. At
that moment, when health feels uncertain, what one needs most is reassurance—the quiet confidence
that someone will handle your concern with care, the certainty that the answers you seek will come
with both precision and thoughtfulness.

## Built on Trust, Backed by Expertise

Since our inception in 1981, we have remained true to one simple promise—diagnostics with a human
touch. From a modest beginning, we have grown into one of India’s most respected diagnostic
networks. We have achieved this feat by providing top-quality diagnostic care and earning the trust
of numerous customers across the country.

Our team today is made up of over 3000 dedicated professionals, including 300+ of India’s leading
specialised and super-specialised radiologists and pathologists. Along with their deep expertise and
technical skills, they bring empathy, compassion, and a strong commitment to patient care.

Every test we conduct is handled with precision and responsibility—because we understand that your
medical reports aren’t just numbers, they’re the foundation of your peace of mind.

We also offer a wide range of [health packages][139] curated for every age group and lifestyle,
ensuring preventive care is accessible and personalised. Understanding that healthcare is not just
about treatment but also about prevention, we have curated a comprehensive suite of preventive
health check-up packages tailored to diverse age groups, health conditions, and lifestyles.

## Accessible Care, Thoughtfully Delivered

Today, Vijaya is present in 6 states, across 25 cities with over [160 centres][140]. Each one of
these centres carries the same hallmark of care. Our centres are spread over multiple locations
across 25+ cities, which means there’s a Vijaya diagnostic centre near you whenever you want
effective diagnostic care. No matter which centre you visit, our philosophy remains unchanged:
offering patients consistent quality, accessible service, and unwavering integrity.

For those who cannot come to us because of health issues, age, or tight schedules, we come to them.
Our [home sample collection][141] service is not just a convenience—it’s a commitment to ensuring
that no one is left behind and care reaches the doorstep of those who need it the most.

## A Quiet Presence in Life’s Important Moments

Every day, people walk into our centres with concerns they may not always say out loud. Some come
alone; some are accompanied by loved ones. Some are looking for answers. Others simply want
reassurance. And in these quiet, crucial moments, we stand beside them, not just as professionals,
but as trusted partners in their journey towards better health.

## Numbers That Speak of Trust, Not Just Growth

Over the last 40+ years, Vijaya has quietly built a legacy rooted in both care and credibility. Our
strength lies in our people—3000+ skilled professionals, including 300+ specialised and super
specialised radiologists and pathologists who bring experience and empathy to their work. We’ve had
the privilege of serving 100+ million individuals, and we are trusted by 450+ organisations across
the country.

## Uncompromising on Quality and Accreditation

Quality is at the heart of Vijaya Diagnostic Centre’s operations—it’s a culture that’s ingrained in
our practices and deep-rooted in our professional approaches. Every process is governed by globally
recognised standards, ensuring your health is always the top priority. Our diagnostic laboratories
are accredited by NABL, our flagship centre is certified under ISO 9001:2015, and our operations
align with NABH protocols to ensure clinical excellence and patient safety.

## Because You Deserve Nothing Less

When you choose Vijaya Diagnostic Centre, you are choosing care that is personal, not transactional.
You are choosing an experience grounded in science and service rooted in empathy. You are choosing a
place where every step—from booking a diagnostic test to reporting—is designed around your comfort.

At every [diagnostic centre][142] under our network, the focus remains the same: accurate diagnosis,
timely reporting, seamless experience, and compassionate communication.

Most importantly, you are choosing a team that understands that behind every test lies a person—a
life, a story, and a hope. And that’s a responsibility we carry with pride.

## Trust Vijaya for Advanced Medical Care

Whether you are looking for a [radiology centre][143] or pathology tests, Vijaya Diagnostic Centre
is the first and ultimate choice. Our vision and reputation have made us the leading name in the
medical sector.

As one of the best [diagnostic centres][144], Vijaya offers world-class support and advanced care,
which can help clinicians diagnose the exact medical issue you are experiencing.

Get in touch with us for the best diagnostic support delivered with professionalism, care, and
empathy.

For any enquiries or more information, Call Us Today!
